official.description: The Government of the People's Republic of China invites outstanding Bangladeshi students to apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) - Type A, administered by the China Scholarship Council, to study at Chinese universities at Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral (PhD) or one-year Chinese language level. The Embassy frames the award as a fully funded scholarship providing full tuition fees, on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, a monthly living allowance and international round-trip airfare.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) / CSC Type A - bilateral Embassy-channel government scholarship

applicant_utility.summary: This is the CSC Type A channel for Bangladeshi nationals: you apply online at www.campuschina.org, the Embassy of China in Dhaka nominates you, and the award pays full tuition, on-campus housing, medical insurance, a CNY 2,500-3,500 monthly allowance plus a round-trip airfare. The last published round closed on 10 January 2026, so Bangladeshi applicants should expect the next call to appear on the Embassy's Press Release page around December and to close roughly three weeks later. Eligibility hinges on hard age caps - under 25 for Bachelor's, under 35 for Master's and under 40 for PhD - and on producing a notarised academic file plus an acceptance or pre-admission letter from a Chinese university. No minimum IELTS or TOEFL score is published, but a language certificate (HSK/IELTS/TOEFL) sits on the Embassy's own document checklist, and Bachelor's applicants must add a valid CSCA score report.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent Bangladeshi school leavers and early-career graduates with strong grades and a clear university choice in China who can work to a short December-to-January window.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your age against the published cap for your level the day the call opens, not just at graduation
Shortlist universities and supervisors on campuschina.org early and secure an acceptance or pre-admission letter, which is a listed document
Book the CSCA test in time if applying at Bachelor's level so a valid score report exists before submission
Arrange notarisation and English translation of transcripts, certificates and the two recommendation letters
Complete the Foreigner Physical Examination Form at an authorised hospital, since it has a fixed validity window
Register a Chinese-language-capable email, since CSC portal verification and admission notices arrive through it
common_rejection_risks: Missing an acceptance or pre-admission letter from the university, which the checklist treats as mandatory
Falling outside the age ceiling for the applied level - the caps are published and are not waived
Submitting an un-notarised or untranslated transcript bundle, or a photocopy instead of a passport copy
Applying for a Chinese-taught programme without the language certificate the checklist asks for
Leaving the CSCA score report absent at Bachelor's level
Losing the interview slot after an incomplete online CSC submission
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The scholarship itself charges no application fee, but applicants must fund their own visa and medical costs, notarisation/translation of academic documents, CSCA or HSK test fees, the medical examination, the trip to Dhaka for the Embassy interview, and any personal spending above the CNY 2,500-3,500 monthly allowance plus what the free dormitory covers.
document_audit: The 'Academic Transcripts & Certificates (Notarized)' entry means both documents, notarised together, in the format CSC's portal accepts
Two separate letters of recommendation are expected - one generic letter does not satisfy the checklist
The Foreigner Physical Examination Form is only valid for a limited period, so do not complete it months before submission
The document checklist names both a CSC form and a university form; forgetting the second is a common failure
Study plan / research proposal is a listed document, so blank or templated versions stand out
alerts: The deadline is a single date for every level - 10 January 2026 for the last round - so late applications ship nothing to the Embassy

The Embassy's own poster names a commercial education agency as its promotional partner; the scholarship has no application fee and no agent is required, so treat paid 'guaranteed admission' offers with caution
Age caps are absolute and measured at application, so repeat or delayed applicants can age out of the level they want
The Embassy's announcement is the only Bangladeshi source for this round; there is no separate CSC Bangladesh page to check
Volunteer support is published as 01332-511837 between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM for queries about the application process
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Create a CSC account at www.campuschina.org, upload the full notarised document set under the Type A (Embassy) channel, submit before the Embassy's deadline, then appear for the interview stage the Embassy lists.
